categories.main_business_segments: China Shineway Pharmaceutical Group Limited primarily operates in the research and development, manufacturing, and trading of modern Chinese medicines. Its product portfolio includes injections, soft capsules, granules, traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) formula granules, and other dosage forms such as pills and tablets. The company also focuses on exclusive oral prescription medications and OTC medications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group integrates modern technological advancements with traditional Chinese medicine, focusing on the modernization and innovation of TCM. It employs intelligent manufacturing and quality control research, including cloud-integrated operations and unmanned workflows in its smart manufacturing facilities. The company also emphasizes research on TCM compound formulas based on ancient classical prescriptions and has developed national standards for TCM formula granules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group serves medical institutions including hospitals at various levels, retail pharmacies, and end consumers across China. Its products are widely used in treating respiratory diseases, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, dermatology, gynecology, and other therapeutic areas. The company’s medications are included in national essential drug lists and medical insurance catalogues, targeting both prescription and OTC markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group's operations and sales are primarily concentrated in the People's Republic of China, including Hong Kong. Key sales regions for TCM formula granules include Hebei and Yunnan provinces, with plans to expand hospital market coverage to additional provinces nationwide. The Group also has subsidiaries in Australia and the British Virgin Islands for investment and R&D purposes.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Shineway Pharmaceutical Group operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and distribution of pharmaceutical products. It also engages in research and development activities upstream to innovate and modernize TCM products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group prioritizes innovation in modern Chinese medicine, emphasizing the development of new medications based on ancient classical prescriptions and clinical trials for innovative TCM products. It invests in smart manufacturing and digital transformation to enhance production efficiency and quality. The company focuses on expanding its exclusive product portfolio, advancing clinical trials, and responding proactively to national healthcare reforms and centralized procurement policies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of pharmaceutical products to wholesale markets, medical institutions, and retail pharmacies. The Group recognizes revenue at the point of product delivery, with credit terms typically ranging from six months to one year. It also benefits from government subsidies related to research and development and investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group is one of the largest producers of TCM formula granules in China, ranking among the top five listed companies in this sector. It competes in a market characterized by intense competition and centralized procurement policies. The company leverages its scale, brand reputation, and technological expertise to maintain a strong market position and expand its market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group recorded revenue of approximately RMB3.78 billion, representing a 16.4% decrease year-on-year, and a net profit of RMB840 million, down 13.4%. Total assets reached RMB10.04 billion with equity attributable to owners at RMB7.47 billion. Despite recent declines due to market and policy challenges, the Group maintains stable profitability and strong cash flow, with ongoing investments in R&D and smart manufacturing.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: China Shineway emphasizes high-quality, efficient, and cost-effective modern Chinese medicines that integrate traditional knowledge with modern technology. Its exclusive products are clinically recognized for efficacy and safety, addressing unmet medical needs in various therapeutic areas. The Group’s commitment to innovation, quality control, and digital transformation differentiates it in the competitive TCM market, supported by strong government policy backing and inclusion in essential drug and medical insurance lists.
